2610.12064.title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
2610.12064.paper_summary: Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.
2610.12064.paper_summary_zh: 數位技術使伊斯蘭敘事變得更易於獲取，但現有平台對於結構化學習和理解這些故事的支持有限，特別是在阿拉伯語和多語言環境中。我們提出了ILM，一個針對先知故事的互動教育平台，結合了阿拉伯語自然語言處理、結構化知識表示和基於檢索的問題生成。經管理員批准的阿拉伯語敘事由知識圖譜(KG)構建引擎處理，該引擎識別實體和敘事關係，並將其存儲為結構化知識，使學習者能夠通過可視化故事地圖探索故事，並回答從KG生成的基於實體和關係的問題。另設有多語言檢索管道，從原始敘事中檢索相關段落，以生成多選和開放式理解問題。對於開放式問題，LLM作為評審，根據檢索到的段落和參考答案評估學習者的回答以確定正確性。該平台還將可蘭經內容作為單獨的豐富層納入，允許選定的敘事補充來源支持的信息。通過將結構化知識與基於段落的檢索相結合，ILM支持阿拉伯語和多語言內容的敘事探索、理解和評估。該系統展示了結構化知識表示和基於檢索的生成相結合以支持伊斯蘭敘事互動學習的可行性。演示版可在anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF獲得。
